profile_text.body:
Elicit is an AI tool built for scientific research, offering capabilities to search, summarize, extract data from, and chat with a corpus the company describes as covering over 125 million papers. The company states the platform is used by over 2 million researchers across academia and industry. Elicit describes its reports as deeply customizable, allowing users to control which papers are included and what information those reports cover, positioning the product as distinct from more general AI tools. The held facts record Elicit as a research assistant product with noted applications in paper analysis, systematic review, and academic integrity.

The site's held facts also show two MCP server entries associated with Elicit, both focused on human-in-the-loop functionality for AI agents. The first, ai.elicitly/elicitly, provides confirmation and form dialogs alongside a capability doctor, while the second, ai.elicitly/pro, adds durable approvals backed by a hosted review page and audit trail. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
